Complete published named EMPLOYEE schedule, physical PDF pages 92–154. Board/committee members, executive component tables, below-threshold aggregates, suppliers and severance summaries are excluded.

Names are preserved as published; positions are not published in this schedule and remain null. Blank/dash expenses remain null, explicit numeric zero remains zero, and parenthesized recoveries remain negative. Known-expense sums do not establish values for unknown cells.

Remuneration includes salary, overtime, taxable benefits and other like amounts paid during the reported year. This employee SOFI measure excludes the separately reconciled employer-paid portion of staff benefits and differs from executive total compensation. The schedule explicitly rounds to the nearest dollar. Surnames plus initials and repeated disclosed names are retained without identity merging.

All row values and controls are independently extracted from the fingerprinted official original PDF. Tiny reproduced differences are source residuals; rounding bounds are comparisons and do not establish their cause.

The source's named subtotal is labelled over/> $75,000. One named row is displayed at exactly $75,000 and is retained as published. The threshold metadata describes the printed selection label; it does not remove that source row or infer an unrounded amount.
